item.title: The Glasswing Paradox: When the Most Responsible AI Company Follows the Oldest Playbook in Capitalism
item.description: Anthropic’s restricted release of Claude Mythos is a genuine act of responsibility. It is also a masterclass in building a monopoly. Both things are true, and the tension between them is the story of AI in 2026.

item.title: Adapt or Die: Rebuilding at 37 in the Age of AI
item.description: What happens when AI doesn’t just threaten your job but actually takes it. A personal account of losing a translation career to large language models and the decision to rebuild from scratch at 37.

item.title: Nobody's Steering, Everyone's Accelerating
item.description: What if the Great Filter isn’t a technological barrier but a coordination failure? A reflection on AI development, market incentives, and collective action at civilizational scale.
